To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the mass difference of 74Rb - 74Kr has been directly measured with high precision, and that the value of this mass difference, combined with existing data for 74Rb's partial half-life and theoretical corrections, yields an experimental determination of deltaC.
we have performed direct mass measurements on the mother and daughter nuclide of the superallowed 74Rb beta decay.

the direct mass measurements on the nuclides 74Rb (T1/2=65 ms) and 74Kr (T1/1/2=15.4 min) were performed for the first time, yielding a decay energy for the beta decay of 74Rb of Q=10 417(5) keV and a comparative half-life for the decay 74R(b+)74Kr of Ft=3083(15) s.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the isospin impurity of the 74Rb ground state is not negligible, and the corresponding isospin-symmetric correction to the Ft value is not negligible either.
the isospin symmetry-breaking corrections for superallowed Fermi transitions in the 74Rb-74Kr pair are small enough to allow for a precise test of isospin symmetry.
